Description

HW_STATUS bytes 0-3. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 HW_STATUS; byte layout follows the corrected usb_ocp_recovery_regs.sv implementation.

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name

Field Descriptions

VENDOR_HW_STATUS_LEN - Vendor HW status length

Byte 3 reports the vendor HW status payload length. Firmware owns the stored byte through cpuif and the USB Recovery Agent reads the same storage. This byte location matches the corrected usb_ocp_recovery_regs.sv layout and OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 HW_STATUS.

CTEMP - Composite temperature

Byte 2 reports composite temperature. Firmware owns the stored byte through cpuif and the USB Recovery Agent reads the same storage. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 HW_STATUS.

VENDOR_HW_STATUS - Vendor HW status

Byte 1 holds the vendor HW status bitmap. Firmware owns the stored byte through cpuif and the USB Recovery Agent reads the same storage. This byte location matches the corrected usb_ocp_recovery_regs.sv layout and OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 HW_STATUS.

RESERVED_7_3 - Reserved

Byte 0 bits 7:3 are reserved. Firmware owns the stored byte through cpuif and the USB Recovery Agent reads the same storage. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 HW_STATUS.

FATAL_ERR - Hardware fatal error

Byte 0 bit 2 reports a hardware fatal error. Firmware owns the stored byte through cpuif and the USB Recovery Agent reads the same storage. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 HW_STATUS.

SOFT_ERR - Hardware soft error

Byte 0 bit 1 reports a hardware soft error. Firmware owns the stored byte through cpuif and the USB Recovery Agent reads the same storage. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 HW_STATUS.

TEMP_CRITICAL - Device temperature critical

Byte 0 bit 0 reports temperature-critical status. Firmware owns the stored byte through cpuif and the USB Recovery Agent reads the same storage. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 HW_STATUS.
